items.html: And of these seven of the Galgalta, four of them are in the aspect of Makifim (surrounding lights), and three of them are in the aspect of Mochin; and these will be clothed below, in the Tifferet, within the Mochin, so that he may create the interiority of souls in all the worlds. And when twelve and nine are combined, their gematria is EHYEH, which is the secret of Ibur, as is known from the Zohar.
